column1: As part of our community focus, we work to increase access
to high-quality computer science education. One of our
primary programs is Amazon Future Engineer, a childhood-
to-career initiative aimed at increasing access to computer
science education for hundreds of thousands of children
and young adults from underserved and underrepresented
communities each year. Amazon Future Engineer is part of
Amazon’s $50 million investment in STEM education. Amazon
Future Engineer has also invested an additional $20 million
in organizations that promote computer science and STEM
